data.name: Info_Question_What
data.value: When an agent doubts, it asks you with options. Each option says how much effort the agent thinks it takes and how many tokens Agent Studio estimates. Your answer reaches the agent as data.

data.name: Info_Question_Actions
data.value: Choose an option with the arrows and press "Answer". Write your own answer if the agent allows it. Press Esc to decide later: the task keeps waiting.

data.name: Info_Monitor_What
data.value: Here you see what each agent does while it works. You see its state, the working memory it uses and what it has consumed. Also what is left of the budget and the usage limit.

data.name: Info_Monitor_Actions
data.value: Look at the bars: they say where each figure comes from. Pause or cancel the run. Answer when an agent asks you something.

data.name: Monitor_Consumption_ButtonHint
data.value: Reads the log of the run and looks for where tokens were spent in excess. It is free and does not use your usage limit.

data.name: Monitor_Consumption_NeverApplied
data.value: Suggestions are never applied by themselves. If you want a change, make it yourself on the canvas or in the settings.

data.name: Monitor_Consumption_AgentButtonHint
data.value: An agent reads the report and proposes improvements. It spends the usage limit of your plan and asks your permission first.

data.name: Monitor_Consumption_Consent
data.value: An agent from a company other than the one that did the work will read the report above. It will also read the usage table. It will not see the text of the prompts. It will propose improvements. It spends the usage limit of your plan. {0}

data.name: Info_Consumption_What
data.value: It looks in the log of the run for where tokens were spent in excess. For example, thin context, retries that fail the same way or models that are too large. Each finding says what it cost and where the figure comes from.

data.name: Info_Consumption_Actions
data.value: Press "Analyze consumption": it is free. Ask an agent to analyze it: it spends usage limit and asks your permission first. Suggestions are never applied by themselves.
